Phase 2 — Independently evaluate the submitted slice and cumulative artifact against SPEC and the approved plan. Materialize the supplied artifact_files in your fresh workfolder and run lint, tests, and property checks under TOOL_POLICY. Flag every variance and return actionable fixes; approve or reject the current slice. Record remaining SPEC requirements and whether SPEC is fully satisfied. Report coverage_percent as null if it was not measured; coverage_at_least_95 is true exactly when the measured coverage is at least 95%. zero_issues is true exactly when you find zero issues.
